description: TY2026: multiple-support agreement (SS 152(d)(3), Form 2120) — an adult child claiming a parent supported jointly with siblings. Nobody provided over half, but the taxpayer provided over 10% and the other >10% contributors waived. The over-half support test is REPLACED by the over-10% test; gross income $3,000 under the $5,300 limit. The base rule's taxpayerProvidedOverHalfSupport fact (no default) is never demanded — the override supersedes it. Qualifying relative: YES.
